officialReferences.selectionFact: Windows ML is the Windows-supported ONNX Runtime distribution; supports x64 and ARM64.
.NET 8 or later and net8.0-windows10.0.17763.0 or later; x64 and ARM64.
Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.ML is the superset package; catalog APIs are in Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning and C# inference uses Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.
Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.ML supports self-contained deployment down to build 17763 without Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Runtime.

officialReferences.pageTitle: Use ONNX APIs in Windows ML
officialReferences.selectionFact: C# uses Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime and the ordinary InferenceSession API surface supplied by Windows ML.

officialReferences.pageTitle: Select execution providers using the ONNX Runtime included in Windows ML
officialReferences.selectionFact: Enumerate OrtEnv.GetEpDevices and explicitly call SessionOptions.AppendExecutionProvider; do not infer the device from a build flag.
CPU and DirectML are included; catalog-acquired optimized EPs require Windows 11 24H2 build 26100 and compatible hardware/drivers.

officialReferences.pageTitle: Windows App SDK and supported Windows releases
officialReferences.selectionFact: Windows App SDK support is bounded by Windows servicing; build 17763 remains relevant for Windows Server 2019/LTSC scope.
Latest stable non-preview/non-experimental Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.ML version observed in the official NuGet V3 index.
Latest .NET 8 SDK is 8.0.423 and runtime is 8.0.29, released 2026-07-14.

selectionBasis: 选择 Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.ML 2.1.74 self-contained 路径，以保留 build 17763 的 RegFree WinRT 支持并避免依赖机器预装 Windows App SDK runtime；同时直接固定 Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning 2.1.74，防止 wrapper 的 [2.1.74,3.0.0) 传递范围在未来 restore 时漂移。项目不引用普通 Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime NuGet 包。
